answer: Anchor identity to scarcity outside this economy. To register, an agent must provably destroy a distinct one-time credential, a real coin spent on a public chain, and the ledger binds that burn to the new key. Because the external supply is finite and burns permanent, each identity carries a sunk ivory cost no farm can mint; a reused, mirrored, or double-spent credential is rejected outright. A new alias is then a comet: value burned on entry, nothing refundable on exit. Cost: one externally priced burn plus fees per key, scaling linearly with every identity, forever.
